sources.title: Lake Michigan Creel Harvest Tables 1998-2024
sources.use: County-by-fishing-mode recurrence and relative magnitude for coho, Chinook, rainbow trout, brown trout and lake trout; this audit uses the pier column for 2022-2024.
sources.limits: County rows do not provide city-specific pier effort and some counties contain more than one port. Harvest estimates are not target-specific catch probability. A zero is not biological absence.

sources.title: Wisconsin's 2024 Open Water Sportfishing Effort and Harvest From Lake Michigan and Green Bay
sources.use: Statewide pier-mode effort, harvest, seasonal timing and the statewide scarcity check for pier lake trout.
sources.limits: The month table combines survey areas. East-shore 2024 direct sampling ran May through September, with spring modeled and October omitted for ramp, pier and shore modes.

sources.title: Close to Home Fishing Opportunities
sources.use: Exact public-pier target identity for the established Wisconsin ports.
sources.limits: Species lists establish targetability, not catch rate or peak magnitude.

sources.title: Lake Michigan Outdoor Fishing Report and archived weekly reports
sources.use: Exact-city or named-pier timing, catch context and qualitative event strength.
sources.limits: Creel-clerk observations cover sampled dates and times and are not standardized city catch rates.

sources.title: Great Lakes creel estimate dashboard, preserved Pier/Dock extract
sources.use: Port-by-month Pier/Dock catch estimates, all-species effort, recurrence and within-species relative magnitude for Ludington, Grand Haven, Manistee and Frankfort-Elberta.
sources.limits: All-species effort is not directed effort, winter coverage is incomplete, and port rows do not identify a particular casting position.

sources.title: Roadmap to Fishing Lake Michigan: Meet your Match!
sources.use: Port-level species identity and broad seasonal corroboration.
sources.limits: Non-exhaustive and port-wide; it does not provide pier catch magnitude.

sources.title: Roadmap to Fishing Lake Huron: Get Hooked on Huron!
sources.use: Port target identity and broad seasonal timing for Harbor Beach, Oscoda and Port Sanilac.
sources.limits: Non-exhaustive and port-wide; exact-pier targetability and qualitative magnitude require local weekly reports.

sources.title: Weekly Fishing Report archive
sources.use: Exact pier, breakwall and river-mouth catch identity, timing and qualitative magnitude for Lake Huron ports and Michigan Lake Michigan corroboration.
sources.limits: Qualitative weekly snapshots do not provide standardized effort; wording such as few, occasional, some, good or slow is used directly rather than replaced by a confidence discount.

sources.authority: Illinois Natural History Survey / Illinois Department of Natural Resources
sources.title: 2023 and 2024 Illinois Lake Michigan creel survey site estimates
sources.use: Waukegan Harbor pedestrian effort and species harvest for April through September.
sources.limits: The site row includes Government Pier and other pedestrian shoreline positions; October through February is outside the cited site survey period.
